listing:description.back: QuickStudy turns the pages you already have into flashcards you will really study. Scan a worksheet, import a PDF or paste your notes, and QuickStudy creates the cards, links each one to its source and organizes everything for you to review only what is pending. [Sections: turn any page into flashcards; study only what is pending today (the Today tab shows one session plus your weakest card); quizzes in a few minutes; know why each answer is right (tap “Por quê?”); learn from every mistake; build the habit (earn a streak freeze per full study week); track progress per subject; private by default (cloud drafts use Apple’s Private Cloud Compute or the QuickStudy server, which creates cards with Anthropic’s Claude, which deletes your text within 30 days; studying works offline); Free and Pro: 10 free AI generations a month, typing cards and all study modes always free and unlimited; Pro offers 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone; charged to your Apple Account; renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.]
listing:description.note: “Hoje mostra” now “A aba Hoje mostra”; button name quoted as “Por quê?”; “Conta Apple” capitalized as Apple Brasil writes it. All factual claims (10 free, 150 Pro, Claude deletes within 30 days, renewal terms) checked and correct.

listing:release_notes.back: QuickStudy 2.0 was rebuilt so you study every day. ONE SESSION A DAY: Today shows only the due cards plus your weakest card; streaks count the days you study and each full study week earns a Streak Freeze. FROM PAGE TO CARDS, FASTER: scan with the camera, choose a photo, import a PDF or paste text; keep using the app while your cards are drafted; every draft is kept by default, tap to edit, swipe to remove. KNOW WHY: each card links back to the page and passage it came from; every answer explains why it is right, and missed cards come back tomorrow. NOW IN YOUR LANGUAGE: QuickStudy is available in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese; cards are drafted in the language of your notes, whatever language your iPhone uses; scanning reads pages in those languages and spell-checking follows the language of each page. QUICKSTUDY PRO: an optional subscription with 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone; typing your own cards and every study mode remain free and unlimited; if a draft would leave your iPhone, QuickStudy asks first.
